Input.Content: The museum calls the Lantern Room its first public expression of a wider education plan. The room opened for a two-week trial. No visitor-learning outcomes were measured. The remaining education plan is a proposal, not an operating program.

Idea.Title: The trial room gives the proposed education plan a public expression, without demonstrated learning benefits.
